title: AI Accessibility Audit: Test the Keyboard Path #Shorts
description:
AI accessibility audit: run a two-part CI gate that catches four deterministic issues, then tests the real keyboard path and proves every focus stop remains visible. Reproduce the exact synthetic fixture: https://github.com/luis-alberto-sanchez-arenas/automationopsai-video-resources/tree/main/examples/agentic-accessibility-gate-2026-09-26

The demo shows 4 → 0 automated violations and 3/6 → 6/6 visible keyboard stops. It does not claim WCAG conformance: manual and assistive-technology review remain required.

Official references:
https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/
https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-not-obscured-minimum.html
https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core

#AIAccessibility #AccessibilityTesting #WCAG22 #Shorts
